translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: MARCOS
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni MARCOS

content: Dos Kodbadnow ki Disas

To id lihad don iddos Allow't Kod-imolloy, id bovolli to pomammut onsi Maria no toho Magdala, si Salome woy si Maria no inoy ni Santiago, su od undiyon dan to lobbong amoy'd busbusan dan to pomammut iddos bangkoy ni Disas.
Na, sollom poron to allow't Linggu to lammi pa id bottuk allow, mid undiyon sikandan to lobbong ni Disas.
To waa pa sikandan id inguma rutun, id po-inturoy ran nid ungketen to, “Ondoy kos od po-ibpit taddot batu no riyot sobbangan to lovongngan din?”
Piru to kod-inguma ran dutun, nokita ran no noko-ibpit don iddos batu.
To id usok don sikandan, nokita ran no duwon sudduwan no mama no moputi kos umpak, woy mid unsad sikandin diyon lomig to kowanan dan, woy novaakkan sikandan.

Kahi rin kandan to, “Yo kow'd kovaakki. Nokosaddoo a nod nangkap kow ki Disas no toho Nazaret no id pakpak diyon to krus. Piru worad sikandin ka-ay, su id badnow ron! Ontongngi row man ikos lugaa nid tawwan kandin.

Na ipanow kow, woy ponudtuu row ini riyot mgo tinodduwan din, labbi ron en ki Pedro. Osengi row no id unna ron si Disas diyot Galilea, woy rutun, od kokita ran sikandin iling taddot id ponudtuu rin kandan.”
Na, id ponleggua ran diyot lovongngan woy id pompaahuy sikandan, su id kookoo ran to mattag allak. Waa ahad sokkad no id ponudtulan dan oyyos novaakkan dan.
Dos Kodpokita ni Disas ki Maria no toho Magdala
[Na, to novadnow ron si Disas to sollom poron to allow't Linggu, unna sikandin id pokita ki Maria no toho Magdala no id losuran dangan to pittun busow nid poleggua rin.
Nopongnga idda, id undiyonnan ni Maria iddos mgo tinodduwan ni Disas. No-ingumannan din sikandan no id ponlanu woy id ponsinoggow.
To norinog dan iddos ponudtulon ni Maria no nokita rin si Disas no novadnow ron, waa ran id pongimbonnaa.
Dos Kodpokita ni Disas diyot Oruwa taddot mgo Tinodduwan Din no id Undiyon to Emaus

Nopongnga id pokita si Disas ki Maria no toho Magdala, id pokita mandad sikandin diyot oruwa taddot mgo tinodduwan din laggun tod ipanow ran pomon diyot bonuwa. Piru waa ran go-os nokokilaa kandin su nopalin kos boyo rin.
Na, id livod sikandan diyot Jerusalem amoy id ponudtuu ran diyot mgo duma ran no nokita ran si Disas, piru waa mandad sikandan id pongimbonnaa.
Dos Kodpokita ni Disas diyot Sopuu-sokkad no Tinodduwan Din

Diyot mori, id pokita si Disas diyot sopuu-sokkad no tinodduwan din laggun tid ka-an dan. Id sawoy rin sikandan, su kulang kos kopomakoy ran woy motoggas kos uu. Oyyos waa ran man id pongimbonnaa taddot osengan to mgo minuvu no nokokita no novadnow ron sikandin.
Na kahin Disas kandan to, “Undiyon kow to langun no tribu ka-ay to ampow't ingod, woy id ponudtuu row kos Moppiyon Dinoggan diyon to langun.
Dos ahad ondoy nod pomakoy woy'd poboutismu, od kotobbus en. Piru iddos konnod pomakoy, od silutan to kopotayan.
Woy dos od pomakoy koddi, od boggayan to kotuusan to kodpuung to mokososoobbu. Oyyos od pokopoleggua sikandan to mgo busow woy od poko-oseng dan to mgo kinohiyan no waa ran nopohinonawwi.
Otid pokosomad sikandan to mgo uwod woy'd poko-inom dan to ahad ondan nod poko-ilu, konna ran od komonnu. Na, od somaddan dan iddos uu tod pongkovohokan woy od ko-uliyan en.”
Dos Kodbatun ki Disas diyot Datas to Langit
Nopongnga mid ikahi si Disas nod Longaggon diyon to mgo tinodduwan din, novatun don sikandin diyot datas to langit, woy mid unsad sikandin lomig to kowanan to Monama.

Na, id ipanow iddos mgo tinodduwan din amoy'd ponudtuu to Moppiyon Dinoggan diyot ahad ingkon no ingod. Id boggayan sikandan tod Longaggon to kotuusan to kodpuung to mokososoobbu amoy od posivonnalan din iddos id ponudtuu ran.]

footnotes.text: Atag to mgo Judio, otid saop don kos allow, idda ron en kos tigkonayan to so-op no allow. De-en diyon to Allow't Kod-imolloy, dii sikandan od puung taman tod saop kos allow.
